description: This file defines a Doctrine ORM entity class 'FilterField' in the OrangeHRM project, representing a filter field associated with report groups, with properties for database columns, relationships, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: FilterField
classes.description: An entity representing a filter field for reports in OrangeHRM, containing properties such as name, SQL clause parts, widget info, and relationships to report groups and filter field selections.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the filter field's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the filter field's unique identifier.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Associates this filter field with a specific ReportGroup.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the filter field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the filter field.

methods.name: getWhereClausePart
methods.description: Returns the SQL WHERE clause segment associated with this filter field.

methods.name: setWhereClausePart
methods.description: Sets the SQL WHERE clause segment.

methods.name: getFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget type used for this filter field, if any.

methods.name: setFilterFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget type for this filter field.

methods.name: getConditionNo
methods.description: Returns the condition number for ordering or identification.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Indicates whether this filter field is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether this filter field is required.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the CSS class name associated with this filter field.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the CSS class name for this filter field.
